## Summary

Product-minded Backend Engineer with 4+ years in fintech payments and 2+ years of product ownership. Builds with Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Redis, and owns the product side of the same problems: writing PRDs, mapping user flows, prioritizing roadmaps and managing partner and business stakeholders. Led the V2 rewrite of a core payment service, took returns from 1 to 5 markets, and cut device provisioning from 45 minutes to under 5. CAPM certified.

## Experience

### Software Engineer, Surfboard Payments Pvt. Ltd. (May 2022 - Present, Chennai, India)

- Led the V2 rewrite of the payment methods service, the path every transaction routes through, replacing a legacy codebase with a modular NestJS implementation and reducing incidents by 40%.
- Owned a Device Management System from zero to launch, defining requirements, data model, access control and provisioning flow; now manages 2,500+ POS terminals across 3 markets and cut provisioning time from ~45 minutes to under 5 minutes.
- Expanded cross-border returns from 1 market (Sweden) to 5 countries by designing country-aware carrier routing, launching new markets without duplicating the return flow.
- Managed the partner API product end to end, onboarding 15+ partner integrations with zero cross-environment security incidents; negotiated API contracts, versioning and deprecation plans with partner teams and standardised their integration documentation.
- Worked in product for 2+ years alongside engineering: wrote PRDs and user stories, mapped user flows and wireframes, and shaped roadmap priorities with business, operations and partner stakeholders.
- Migrated the returns platform from Fraktjakt to nShift/Unifaun behind a provider-agnostic carrier abstraction; both providers run live and are selected by environment flag, so rollback is a config change, not a redeploy.
- Redesigned the merchant return-label journey into a single click: one approval books the shipment, fetches the label and emails it to the merchant, removing a manual book-download-send process.
- Consolidated duplicated business logic across ~87 microservices into shared modules and scaled instances and compute on bottleneck services, improving p95 latency from 1.2s to 0.8s at peak load.
- Optimized Prisma/PostgreSQL schemas using JSONB for dynamic merchant onboarding and targeted indexes, making queries 60-70% faster; hardened the data layer with a thread-safe connection module with graceful shutdown and proactive error handling.
- Identified alert fatigue in ad-hoc Slack alerts and shipped an internal ticketing workflow (raise, monitor, resolve) for critical events, cutting time to acknowledge by 50%.
- Identified repetitive operations work and delivered AI agents and workflow automations for device diagnostics, partner queries and deployment checks, saving 4+ hours of manual work per week.

### Software Development Intern, Core Illustrio Pvt. Ltd. (Feb 2022 - Apr 2022, Chennai, India)

- Built a Library Management System in Node.js and Fastify with role-based access control (RBAC), with separate admin and user interfaces over 1,000+ book and employee records.
- Prototyped an expense-sharing mobile app in Flutter, implementing the backend business logic and API layer end to end.

## Projects

- [AI Diff Reviewer](https://github.com/Santhosh-Rubenraj-Solomon/ai-diff-reviewer) (Bun, Gemini): pre-push code review tool that feeds the model the repository's own history of the exact lines changed; every finding must survive a counter-argument before it is reported, and zero comments is a valid result.
- [AI-DS Ledger Reconciler](https://github.com/Santhosh-Rubenraj-Solomon/AI_agents) (NestJS, Redis): distributed reconciler for duplicate payment webhooks across a cluster. The Redis lock is held past success so its TTL doubles as an idempotency window; an AI agent inspects the shared ledger and heals drifted transaction states.
- Car Repossession Rate Dashboard (Node.js, SQLite): backend and dashboard replacing manual spreadsheet tracking of repossession rates; segments risk by credit band, days past due and region, and ranks overdue accounts by next action.
